findings.claim: The assessment treats an existing rules renderer and node:test suite as present, but the packet file tree does not contain the cited implementation or test files.
findings.evidence: The assessment claims: "20 node:test tests pass", "all 20 tests in rules/test/render.test.mjs", and "parseConf (rules/lib/render.mjs:25)". The file_tree lists "./rules/lib" and "./rules/test" only as directories and lists no "./rules/lib/render.mjs" or "./rules/test/render.test.mjs"; the only .mjs file explicitly listed under rules is "./rules/build.mjs".
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile the assessment with the actual tree: either include the missing files in the packet/tree evidence or remove/qualify all claims about render.mjs, render.test.mjs, test counts, coverage, and CRLF parser behavior derived from them.

findings.claim: The baseline summary contradicts the later goal assessment by saying none of the five goals has any implementation while later marking two goal areas as partial.
findings.evidence: The opening states: "none of the phase's five goals has any implementation." Later it states: "node:test harness: PARTIAL — 20 node:test tests pass" and ".gitattributes + CRLF tolerance: NOT MET — no .gitattributes; tolerance exists in one untested line and one parser rejects CRLF outright."
findings.suggested_fix: Change the baseline to distinguish missing deliverables from partial pre-existing capability, e.g. "no goal is fully implemented; node:test and limited CRLF handling are partial."

findings.claim: The cross-tool progress finding cites progress.json even though the packet tree contains no such file.
findings.evidence: The assessment says: "progress.json was last written by kbd-new-phase". The file_tree under .kbd-orchestrator lists only "constraints.md", "current-waypoint.json", "model-preflight.json", "phases", and "project.json"; no progress.json appears anywhere.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the actual tracked progress file from the tree, add the missing file to the packet if it exists, or remove the progress.json-specific claim.
